english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for needing rest or sleep.

exampleSentences.english: I’m really tired after work today and want to go to bed early.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我今日返工返到好攰，想早啲瞓。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 faan1 dou3 hou2 gui6 soeng2 zou2 di1 fan3

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who is very tired.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gui6

english.note: Use this for a person who is worn out or exhausted, rather than for a damaged object.

exampleSentences.english: I've walked all day today and I'm worn out.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我今日行足成日，攰到唔想郁。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 haang4 zuk1 seng4 jat6 gui6 dou3 m4 soeng2 juk1

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being physically tired and for a visibly tired expression, such as 笑得好攰.

exampleSentences.english: I walked all day today and feel weary.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我今日行咗成日，攰到唔想郁。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 haang4 zo2 seng4 jat6 gui6 dou3 m4 soeng2 juk1

english.note: Use this for a person or animal that is exhausted from exertion, rather than merely old or physically worn.

exampleSentences.english: After playing a soccer match, I was so worn-out that I didn't even want to walk up the stairs.
exampleSentences.traditional: 踢完場波，我攰到連樓梯都唔想行。
exampleSentences.jyutping: tek3 jyun4 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 gui6 dou3 lin4 lau4 tai1 dou1 m4 soeng2 haang4

english.note: Use 攰 for the adjective meaning exhausted, with the context showing that the tiredness is extreme.

exampleSentences.english: I was dead tired after moving house today.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我今日搬完屋，真係攰到郁唔到。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 bun1 jyun4 uk1 zan1 hai6 gui6 dou3 juk1 m4 dou2
